underspecified_points.hole: Which thin estimate x_tilde the operator fit runs against (trilinear up-sample versus the model's own output) is left open, and the two carry different bias because the up-sampled input has an already-suppressed through-plane spectrum.
underspecified_points.fill: Design decision along the axis: an input-only fit is model-independent and auditable but biased toward wider widths; a fit against the model output is sharper but couples the certificate to the model it is meant to audit. Whichever is chosen must be fixed before results and reported, and the alternative should appear as one extra column.

underspecified_points.hole: What constitutes one 'protocol' for the tail-recovery calibration is undefined, and it determines when a refit is mandatory.
underspecified_points.fill: Design decision along the axis: scanner model / reconstruction kernel / nominal thickness, or the full tuple. A narrow definition means frequent refits and little transfer; a broad one risks a calibration that silently does not apply. The certificate must carry the tag it was fitted under either way.

underspecified_points.hole: The number of real pairs the bias-only control arm may consume to fit its single scalar is unspecified, yet the strength of the paper's central claim depends on it.
underspecified_points.fill: Design decision along the axis of sample size: report the arm as a curve over 1, 3, 5, 10, 25 pairs rather than one number, since 'a handful of pairs reproduces full fine-tuning' is a much stronger claim than 'the training set reproduces it'.

underspecified_points.hole: Whether the 8 mm result is claimed on real or only simulated data is unresolved, and no public real 8 mm paired data exists.
underspecified_points.fill: Design decision along the axis of scope: restrict the 8 mm claim to the simulated arm and state that explicitly, or acquire private real 8 mm pairs and defer the claim to that data.

enriched_steps.what_changes: Read each paired series with SimpleITK, un-normalise to HU when the source ships normalised values (RPLHR-CT stores (HU+1024)/3072 clipped to [0,1]; verify per case by checking that the air peak lands at -1024 HU and the mediastinal soft-tissue peak at +30..+60 HU), clip to [-1000, 200] HU, compute the lung bounding box on the thin volume by 3D connected-component labelling of voxels < -400 HU with in-plane-border-touching components removed, apply that box to both series (z indices divided by r for the thick one), estimate the slab offset by minimising ||A_w(thin) - thick||^2 over integer shifts in [-4, +4] thick slices, and trim so D_thin = r * D_thick exactly. Write <case>_thin.npy / <case>_thick.npy plus one audit row per case (offset, match MSE, lung fraction). The simulated arm reuses the same thin crops with A_w applied at a known w drawn per case from a stated range.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_en: Load each thick/thin pair, convert to real HU units, crop both to the same lung box, slide the thick series by up to +-4 slices to find the alignment that matches best, cut both so the thin one is exactly r times as many slices, and save them as a pair with a one-line audit record. Build the simulated arm from the same thin crops using a known blur width.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_zh: 读取每一对厚/薄层序列，先换算回真实 HU，再把两者裁到同一个肺部包围盒；在 ±4 层范围内平移厚层找到最佳对齐，裁到薄层层数正好是厚层的 r 倍，成对保存并写一行审计记录。合成臂用同样的薄层裁块、以已知的模糊宽度生成。

enriched_steps.what_changes: Implement the fit as a loop over w in numpy.arange(2.00, 12.001, 0.25): build the normalised sampled Gaussian k_w with radius ceil(3*sigma(w)), convolve along z with replicate padding, average-pool by r, and record the mean squared error against y over the eroded lung interior. Return w_hat = argmin, the full error profile (so its curvature and any grid-endpoint saturation are inspectable), sigma_hat = 1.4826 * MAD of the z first differences inside the lung set divided by sqrt(2), and rho = ||A_{w_hat}(x_hat) - y||_2 / ||y - mean(y)||_2. Cost is 41 blur-and-pool passes, seconds per case on GPU. 【author decision: whether x_tilde for the fit is the trilinear up-sampling of y or the model's own current output - the two give different bias, and the run must report which was used】
enriched_steps.what_to_do_en: Try every candidate slice width from 2 to 12 mm in 0.25 mm steps: blur the thin estimate by that width, average it down to thick slices, and see which width best reproduces the actual thick scan. Keep the winner, the whole error curve, a robust noise estimate, and the fraction of the scan the winner still fails to explain. 【author decision: fit against the simple up-sampled thick scan, or against the network's own output - report which】
enriched_steps.what_to_do_zh: 在 2 到 12 mm 之间以 0.25 mm 为步长逐个试：用该宽度模糊薄层估计、再平均成厚层，看哪个宽度最能重现真实厚层。保留最优值、整条误差曲线、稳健的噪声估计，以及最优解释仍解释不了的比例。【作者需决定：拟合时用三线性上采样的厚层，还是用网络自身输出，二者偏差不同，须在结果中注明】

enriched_steps.what_changes: Replace the constant conditioning vector in the identification module: where the current code computes fwhm_to_sigma(5.0) and broadcasts it, feed the per-sample (w_hat, sigma_hat) pair through the existing FiLM path, normalised to zero mean and unit variance using statistics computed once over the training set (store them with the checkpoint so inference matches). Everything downstream is unchanged, so the effect is visible directly in x_hat and in every statistic computed from it.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_en: Swap the fixed slice-width number the network is told for the one just estimated from this scan, standardised the same way for training and inference.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_zh: 把网络里写死的标称层厚换成刚刚从这次扫描估计出来的值，训练与推理使用同一套标准化统计量。

enriched_steps.what_changes: Fit the tail-recovery relation as a ridge regression of Var_z(x) on the features [Var_z(y), w_hat, sigma_hat, Var_z(y)*w_hat] over training pairs only (both arms), with 5-fold grouping BY CASE so no case appears in both fit and evaluation folds; sigma_v is the standard deviation of the held-out residuals. Refuse to ship the term when sigma_v exceeds the between-case standard deviation of Var_z(x) itself, i.e. when the relation carries no information. Persist (coefficients, sigma_v, protocol tag) next to the checkpoint. 【author decision: what defines a protocol tag - scanner model, kernel, nominal thickness, or the tuple - since it sets when a refit is required】
enriched_steps.what_to_do_en: Learn, from training scans only, how much through-plane texture the thick scan implies the thin one should have, and measure how far off that prediction typically is on scans it never saw; if the prediction is no better than guessing the average, do not ship this term at all. 【author decision: what counts as one protocol for calibration purposes】
enriched_steps.what_to_do_zh: 只用训练集的配对学出「厚层暗示薄层应有多少纵向纹理」这一关系，并在没见过的病例上测出它的典型误差；如果这个预测并不比直接猜平均值更好，就不要发布这一项。【作者需决定：标定意义上的「同一 protocol」如何界定】

enriched_steps.what_changes: Build the thick-grid lung set L from the HU window (hu_air_floor, hu_lung_ceiling) = (-990, -500), erode it with scipy.ndimage.binary_erosion using an in-plane structuring element of radius e_mask = 8 and a z element of ceil(3*sigma(w_max)/r) slices, then compute delta_hat = mean over L_e of (A_{w_hat}(x_hat) - y) in HU, rho_struct = ||R - delta_hat||_2 / ||y - mean(y)||_2, and s = (v_hat - Var_z(x_hat))/sigma_v when a calibration for this protocol exists (else s = UNAVAILABLE). Emit ABSTAIN when |L_e| = 0. Write one CSV row per case with all six quantities plus LAA-950 and Perc15, so the endpoint and its evidence are never separable in the record.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_en: Mark the lung voxels on the thick grid, shrink that mask inward so no averaged voxel borrows from outside it, then compute three numbers: the plain overall shift, the leftover structural mismatch, and (if calibrated) the texture term - and write them into the same CSV row as the emphysema numbers.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_zh: 在厚层网格上标出肺区，向内腐蚀掩膜使参与平均的体素不会借到区外信息，然后算三个数：整体平移、剩余结构失配、以及（若已标定）纹理项，并把它们与肺气肿指标写进同一行 CSV。

enriched_steps.what_changes: Run step S5 verbatim with x_hat := the TRUE thin volume on every held-out real pair, and record the per-term distribution: delta_hat should concentrate near its floor (measured -0.55 HU on one real pair, with the width-sweep spread 0.04 HU over w in [4,10] mm), s near zero in units of sigma_v. Any term whose null distribution is wider than its own threshold is reported as an estimator bias in the paper and is NOT used to gate that arm. This is a pure evaluation pass: no training, no gradients.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_en: Feed the real thin scan in place of a reconstruction and check each certificate number returns the value it should for a perfect answer; if a number condemns the perfect answer, report it as a limitation of the measuring stick rather than using it to judge models.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_zh: 把真实薄层直接当作「重建结果」送进去，检查证书里每一项是否都回到完美答案该有的取值；若某一项连完美答案都判不合格，就把它作为量尺自身的局限如实报告，而不用它去评判模型。

enriched_steps.what_changes: Add lambda_delta * |delta_hat| to the existing composite loss. delta_hat must be computed with the same differentiable operator used in the data-consistency term so the gradient reaches the network; detach w_hat (the fit is not differentiated through, which keeps the operator solver a sound solver rather than a second learned branch). Train with the existing recipe (gradient-norm clipping at 1.0, weight EMA 0.999) and sweep lambda_delta over {0.1, 0.3, 1, 3, 10}.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_en: Add the size of the overall shift to the training loss, letting gradients flow through the blur-and-pool operator but not through the width estimate itself, and sweep how strongly it is weighted.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_zh: 把整体平移的绝对值加进训练损失，让梯度经过模糊+平均算子回传，但不对层厚估计本身求导，并对该项权重做扫描。

enriched_steps.what_changes: Implement the arbiter as a pure function certificate -> {certified, flagged(term), abstain}, with thresholds tau_delta = 2 HU, tau_rho = 0.15, tau_s = 2 sigma_v, each swept over the stated range; report the operating characteristic (fraction certified versus achieved endpoint error) rather than a single threshold choice, since the useful output is the trade-off curve a trial can pick from.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_en: Turn the certificate into certified / flagged / abstain with stated thresholds, and publish the whole trade-off curve between how many scans get certified and how accurate the certified ones are.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_zh: 用给定阈值把证书变成通过/标记/弃权，并给出「通过比例 — 通过者精度」的整条权衡曲线，而不是只报一个阈值下的结果。

enriched_steps.what_changes: One evaluation script, five arms, identical data loader, identical lung masks, identical patch geometry: trilinear up-sampling; the existing restoration model; that model fine-tuned on real pairs; that model with ONLY its output bias shifted by the value fitted on a small number of real pairs; and ARC-CT. Report LAA-950 MAE and Lin's concordance, Perc15 MAE, PSNR, plus the full certificate per case. The harness must refuse to print an endpoint without its certificate columns. 【author decision: how many real pairs the bias-only arm may use for its single scalar - the arm's whole point is that it needs very few, so the number is a claim, not a detail】
enriched_steps.what_to_do_en: Run all five versions through exactly the same evaluation code, and report the emphysema numbers together with the certificate for every one of them. 【author decision: how many real pairs the bias-only version is allowed to use】
enriched_steps.what_to_do_zh: 用完全相同的评测代码跑这五个版本，并且每个版本都必须同时报出指标和证书。【作者需决定：仅校正偏置的那个版本允许用多少对真实配对来拟合这一个标量】

enriched_steps.what_changes: Four ablation runs: (a) w_hat frozen at 5.00 mm everywhere (operator solver removed) - expect the displacement term to be absorbed into rho and the arm to lose its separation power; (b) lambda_delta = 0; (c) conditioning removed while the certificate is still computed; (d) e_mask swept over {4, 6, 8, 10, 12} at evaluation time only. Each ablation reports the same table as S9 so the marginal effect of each solver is read off directly.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_en: Turn off one component at a time and re-run the same table, so a reader can see exactly which part carries the result.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_zh: 每次只关掉一个组件并重跑同一张表，让读者直接看出结果由哪一部分承担。

enriched_steps.what_changes: Re-run the whole pipeline with r = 8 and the simulated 8 mm arm (the 8 mm real pairs are not public), keeping every threshold and hyper-parameter at its 5 mm value; the operator solver should return a wider w_hat without any code change. Report the same joint table. 【author decision: whether to also claim 8 mm real-pair performance - the public data does not support it, so the honest scope is simulated 8 mm plus the 5 mm real result】
enriched_steps.what_to_do_en: Do the whole thing again for 8 mm slices with nothing retuned, and report the same table. 【author decision: keep the 8 mm claim to simulated data, since public real 8 mm pairs do not exist】
enriched_steps.what_to_do_zh: 在 8 mm 层厚上原样重跑，不调任何超参，并报同一张表。【作者需决定：8 mm 的结论应限定在合成数据上，因为没有公开的真实 8 mm 配对】

enriched_steps.what_changes: Plot the per-case distribution of (rho, rho_struct, delta_hat, s) for the simulated arm against the real arm, and regress the per-case endpoint error on rho_struct; the claim under test is that the unexplained residual is what predicts the simulated-to-real gap, so it needs the scatter plus its correlation, not a mean comparison.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_en: Compare the certificate's spread on simulated versus real scans and check whether the unexplained part predicts, case by case, how much worse the emphysema number gets.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_zh: 对比证书各项在合成臂与真实臂上的分布，并检验「解释不了的那部分」能否逐例预测肺气肿指标变差的程度。
